Override 462 Auton Planner

click adds · shift-click multi-selects · click a segment inserts · drag moves · arrows nudge · dbl-click / ⌫ deletes
start + heading forward reversed DSR reset goal (corner snap, rear aligner only) pin (snap to intake) · red segment = nose-first at a goal · side bars = toggles, click to cycle

Autons

Points

Point

Actions and DSR run after arriving. A smooth point with an action or wait still stops there. Small hollow dots on the path are automatic goal detours.

points selected

Shift-click points (on the field or in the list) to add or remove them. Dragging any selected point moves the whole selection.

Export / Import

The download bundles all autons (goal detours included) for the SD card as /usd/autons.json — each shows up in the selector by name. Play is an approximation for pacing, not a physics sim.
